description:
*"I left your memories behind because that's the only way this world can endure. Emo, you are the only one who can save the world."*

The war was won, but the wheat harvest was a total disaster! The Ripolka Empire, struck by a great famine due to the curse cast by the defeated Demon King in his final moments after losing to the hero. I, Eudemonian Plenus, was born into this land bearing the historical mission of advancing the continent's food culture, carrying the knowledge of my past life! People starve to death with nothing to eat, yet they refuse to eat potatoes, sweet potatoes, or tomatoes... The young lord's continental version of the ‘Three Meals a Day’ project!

 *“Young Master was born with a blessing for food. Though my power is weak and I could not see the vision for long, countless foods I had never seen in my lifetime existed in Young Master's future. He will live his entire life without hunger, eating delicious things to his heart's content.”*

What good is being a sage in spirit if my body is that of a baby? Can I really do this? Oh dear, this is bad!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
